name: Itsuki (Japan)
description: A grey field charged at the centre with the Itsuki village emblem in green and white: a green disc bearing a white hourglass-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Itsuki, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 September 1971.

features.role: Itsuki village emblem — a green disc bearing a white hourglass-like device
